searchText: There is already a full team working on every one of these topics, including the plug into geth. I don't think it's a good target for apprenticeship, but if you want to proceed anyway with another client, we are happy with providing pointers. I have one question regarding KZG-commitments. If C is a commitment to a vector v, and v' is an updated vector where some of the elements of v are changed, I presume it is possible to compute an updated commitment C' of v', just by knowing C and the old and new values of the updated elements? And this property is necessary for making witness size much smaller for Verkle tries than for Merkle tries, right? yes, you can do that I don't think that property is necessary for making *witness size smaller* But it definitely is very useful for making witness updating time faster Ah actually, sorry, the property is necessary for making witness size smaller, if the function of the witness includes proving the new state root after a series of updates Yeah, verifying the new state root was what I had in mind. I suppose this property follows directly from the linearity of KZG-commitments: to compute C' you just add the commitment of v' - v to C, right? Yeah, you can add commitments, `[a_0, a_1, ..., a_n]` + `[b_0, b_1, ..., b_n]` = `[a_0 + b_0, a_1 + b_1, ..., a_n + b_n]`. Yep!

excerpts.author: albusdompeldorius
excerpts.content: I have one question regarding KZG-commitments. If C is a commitment to a vector v, and v' is an updated vector where some of the elements of v are changed, I presume it is possible to compute an updated commitment C' of v', just by knowing C and the old and new values of the updated elements? And this property is necessary for making witness size much smaller for Verkle tries than for Merkle tries, right?

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: I don't think that property is necessary for making *witness size smaller*

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: But it definitely is very useful for making witness updating time faster

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: Ah actually, sorry, the property is necessary for making witness size smaller, if the function of the witness includes proving the new state root after a series of updates

excerpts.author: albusdompeldorius
excerpts.content: Yeah, verifying the new state root was what I had in mind. I suppose this property follows directly from the linearity of KZG-commitments: to compute C' you just add the commitment of v' - v to C, right?

excerpts.author: peter.davies
excerpts.content: Yeah, you can add commitments, `[a_0, a_1, ..., a_n]` + `[b_0, b_1, ..., b_n]` = `[a_0 + b_0, a_1 + b_1, ..., a_n + b_n]`.
